_howTo: Copy this file; do not edit the template in place.
One entry per value you can read on the page (truth), exactly as printed; page numbers are 1-based.
valueRaw is the printed text ("<5", "4.1"); valueNum the number or null; comparator one of <,>,<=,>= or null; unit as printed; refLow/refHigh numbers or null.
provenance.kind must be human_annotated for real work; double annotation + adjudication is required before any accuracy statement.
Run: npm run validate -- ocr --annotations your-annotations.json --results your-results.json --out report.json
